judged_text: The rewritten Admin::GroupsController#update's non-automatic path — persisting the new flat param contract `params[:name]`/`params[:alias_level]`/`params[:visible]` (groups_controller.rb lines 37-40) — is covered by no test: the diff deletes `it "is able to update group members"` (the only spec that asserted a normal group's rename persisted, `group.name.should == 'fred'`) and the surviving `.update` spec in this, the diff's only test file (checked: spec/controllers/admin/groups_controller_spec.rb is the sole spec changed; its .index/.create/.update/.destroy/.refresh_automatic_groups/.add_members/.remove_member contexts contain no non-automatic update test), exercises only the automatic-group branch, so the restructured param shape and the alias_level assignment (asserted nowhere in the entire suite) are unverified. A dropped or misnamed parameter in update (e.g. `params[:alias_lvl]`) ships with a fully green suite; admins editing a regular group via the admin UI's Save button — which PUTs exactly these flat params through Group#asJSON — receive `success_json` on an untouched record, so name/alias_level/visibility edits silently fail to persist while the UI reports success.
